title: Enterprise Support: Disjoint physical quantity addition for physical-quantity reconciliation
content:
Enterprise Support — Disjoint physical quantity addition for physical-quantity reconciliation.

## Decision basis

For physical-quantity reconciliation: Add converted recognized hours and the disjoint supplemental baseline export hours to obtain the quantity covered by the review.

## Hypothetical case

For physical-quantity reconciliation: Suppose converted recognized hours are hypothetically 120 and disjoint baseline hours are 80. The review covers 200 vCPU-hours.
